title: "02 Clean"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
editor: visual
---

Turn the loaded tables into tidy tables and write `data/02_dat_clean.tsv` and `data/02_dat_clean_meta.tsv`.

Peptide rows are not tidy yet: several peptides sit in one comma-separated cell, and the CDR3, V gene and J gene are packed into `TCR BioIdentity`. The HLA columns `A1`–`C2` are wide (one column per allele copy), so the metadata gets pivoted longer.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)

peptide_data <- read_tsv(here("data", "01_dat_load.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
meta_data <- read_tsv(here("data", "01_dat_load_meta.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| warning: false

# most rows have fewer than 13 peptides; separate() fills the rest with NA
peptide_data <- peptide_data |>
  select(Experiment, `TCR BioIdentity`, `Amino Acids`) |>
  separate(
    col = `TCR BioIdentity`,
    into = c("CDR3b", "V_gene", "J_gene"),
    sep = "\\+"
  ) |>
  separate(
    col = `Amino Acids`,
    into = str_c("peptide_", seq(1, 13)),
    sep = ",",
    fill = "right"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = str_c("peptide_", seq(1, 13)),
    names_to = "peptide_n",
    values_to = "peptide"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(peptide), peptide != "") |>
  filter(
    str_detect(CDR3b, "[^ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV]", negate = TRUE),
    str_detect(peptide, "[^ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV]", negate = TRUE)
  ) |>
  select(-peptide_n)

peptide_data |> slice_head(n = 5)
```

```{r}
meta_data <- meta_data |>
  rename(
    A1 = `HLA-A...9`,
    A2 = `HLA-A...10`,
    B1 = `HLA-B...11`,
    B2 = `HLA-B...12`,
    C1 = `HLA-C...13`,
    C2 = `HLA-C...14`
  ) |>
  select(Experiment, Cohort, Age, Gender, Race, A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2),
    names_to = "Gene",
    values_to = "Allele"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Allele), Allele != "")

meta_data |> slice_head(n = 8)
```

```{r}
write_tsv(peptide_data, here("data", "02_dat_clean.tsv"))
write_tsv(meta_data, here("data", "02_dat_clean_meta.tsv"))
```
